name: status-bar
description: A row above the message box with the session's Linear ticket, its state and Figma frames, the pull request's preview links, and how far the merged change has deployed

workspace.title: Linear workspace
workspace.description: The workspace's URL key, the acme in linear.app/acme/issue/ACME-1, for a link before the pull request body carries one

linearApiKey.title: Linear API key
linearApiKey.description: A personal API key from Linear (Settings > Security & access), to show each ticket's Figma frames and exact URL. Stored in secure storage. Optional.

stages.title: Deploy stages
stages.description: Branches a merged pull request moves through, in order, as branch=label pairs: main=dev, qa=qa, prod=prod shows on dev, on qa or on prod. Empty hides the stage.

previewLinks.title: Preview links
previewLinks.description: Links to an open pull request's preview deployment as label=URL pairs, {number} standing for the pull request number: Preview=https://pr-{number}.preview.example.com. Empty hides the preview.

previewWorkflow.title: Preview workflow
previewWorkflow.description: The GitHub Actions workflow file that deploys a preview, such as pr-preview.yml. Its newest run on the pull request's branch says whether the preview is deploying, failed or ready.

previewIdleHours.title: Preview lifetime (hours)
previewIdleHours.description: Hours after its last deploy that a preview is torn down; an older preview is not shown.
